title: Wizard in Ancient Chamber
description: A hooded figure in a brown robe kneels on a stone floor with both hands touching glowing orange marks and runes painted on the ground. The setting is a dark stone room with a large carved door leaking molten orange light, scattered scrolls, an overturned pot, and a night sky with a crescent moon visible through an opening.
